target.title: fix(gateway): keep worker SSH tunnel stderr tails UTF-16 safe
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Worker SSH tunnel failure details keep a rolling stderr/stdout tail with raw UTF-16 `.slice(-4096)` before `processError()` embeds them in the operator-facing `Error`. When remote diagnostic text has an emoji or other non-BMP character exactly at the left edge of that retained window, the thrown message can start with a lone low surrogate (often rendered as U+FFFD).

This hits the production `createWorkerSshRunner()` path used by `createWorkerTunnelManager` when an SSH tunnel child exits before the ready marker.

## Why This Change Was Made

Reuse `sliceUtf16Safe` from `@openclaw/normalization-core/utf16-slice` through a small `appendBoundedDiagnosticTail` helper, matching sibling worker-environments truncation in `bootstrap.ts` / `service.ts` and the bounded stderr-tail pattern used by file-transfer. Keep the 4096-unit cap and redaction/whitespace folding in `processError()` unchanged; only the rolling buffer retention becomes surrogate-safe.

Also pass the required `CommandOptions.timeoutMs` in the regression spawn options so `check-test-types` stays green after `timeoutMs` became mandatory on that type.

This is a display-layer root-cause fix for the failure detail string. It does not change SSH forwarding, ready-marker detection semantics for ASCII markers, reconnect/backoff, or success paths.

## User Impact

**Before:** A worker SSH tunnel failure whose remote stderr crossed the 4096-unit rolling window on an emoji could show a corrupted leading character in the Error message.

**After:** The same failure detail drops the incomplete surrogate at the window edge, so operators get a well-formed diagnostic string.

## Evidence

- Changed: `src/gateway/worker-environments/tunnel.ts` (`createWorkerSshRunner` stdout/stderr ring buffer)
- Regression: `src/gateway/worker-environments/tunnel.test.ts` → `keeps SSH tunnel failure stderr on a valid UTF-16 boundary`
- Caller path under test: real `createWorkerSshRunner().start(...)` → child stderr → `processError(stderr)` → `ready` rejection

### Unit regression

```bash
node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/gateway/worker-environments/tunnel.test.ts --reporter=verbose
```

```text
 ✓ |gateway-core| ... > keeps SSH tunnel failure stderr on a valid UTF-16 boundary 45ms
 ✓ |gateway-server| ... > keeps SSH tunnel failure stderr on a valid UTF-16 boundary 45ms
 ✓ |gateway-client| ... > keeps SSH tunnel failure stderr on a valid UTF-16 boundary 44ms
 ✓ |gateway-methods| ... > keeps SSH tunnel failure stderr on a valid UTF-16 boundary 44ms
 Test Files  4 passed (4)
      Tests  28 passed (28)
[test] passed 1 Vitest shard in 6.80s
```

## Real behavior proof

- **Behavior or issue addressed:** Worker SSH tunnel operator Error details no longer split UTF-16 surrogate pairs at the 4096-unit rolling stderr tail.
- **Canonical reachability path:** `createWorkerTunnelManager` → default `createWorkerSshRunner().start(...)` → child `stderr` data handler → `appendBoundedDiagnosticTail` → close → `processError(stderr)` → `ready` rejection `Error.message`.
- **Boundary crossed:** Remote SSH process stderr/stdout text → redacted/collapsed operator Error detail.
- **Shared helper / provider constraint check:** Uses existing `sliceUtf16Safe`; same helper family already used by worker-environments `service.ts` / bootstrap failure details and file-transfer bounded stderr tails.
- **Real environment tested:** Local Node 22 source checkout; standalone `tsx` script (outside Vitest) calling production `createWorkerSshRunner().start(...)` with a real spawned Node child writing an oversized stderr payload and exiting non-zero.
- **Exact steps or command run after this patch:**

```bash
node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/gateway/worker-environments/tunnel.test.ts --reporter=verbose
# plus standalone tsx proof invoking createWorkerSshRunner() against a real child process
```

- **Evidence after fix:**

```text
standalone-proof: createWorkerSshRunner stderr UTF-16 boundary
{
  "behavior": "SSH tunnel stderr rolling tail",
  "payloadLength": 4098,
  "rawLength": 4096,
  "rawStartsWithLoneLow": true,
  "rawFirstCodeUnit": "de00",
  "detailLength": 4095,
  "detailStartsWithLone": false,
  "detailFirstCodeUnit": "62",
  "detailEqualsRetained": true,
  "hasReplacement": false,
  "hasEmoji": false
}
standalone-proof: done

 ✓ ... > keeps SSH tunnel failure stderr on a valid UTF-16 boundary
 Test Files  4 passed (4)
      Tests  28 passed (28)
```

- **Observed result after fix:** For stderr of `a` + emoji + 4095 `b` characters, raw `.slice(-4096)` still starts on a lone low surrogate (`de00`), while the production Error detail is exactly the 4095-character ASCII `b` prefix—no emoji, no U+FFFD, no lone low surrogate.
- **What was not tested:** Live SSH against a real remote worker host; Windows (test skipped on win32; no Windows-specific behavior change in the helper path).
- **Fix classification:** Root cause fix

- [x] I understand what the code does
- [x] Change is focused and does not mix unrelated concerns
